What We Do

Everything we handle, start to finish

From routine cleaning to full repairs and replacement — here's the full lineup for your ducts, dryer vents, attic, and chimney.

Duct Cleaning

Clearing dust, debris, and buildup from your supply and return ducts.

Dryer Vent Cleaning

Clearing the full vent run — lint buildup is a real fire risk and it slows your dryer down.

Dryer Vent Repair

Fixing crushed, disconnected, or damaged vent runs so your dryer vents properly again.

Duct Repair

Patching leaks, gaps, and damaged sections so your system isn't losing conditioned air.

Duct Replacement

Swapping out old, worn, or undersized ductwork for a properly sized system.

Sanitation Process

Treating ducts for mold, mildew, and odor as part of the job.

Attic Installation

Installing and fitting attic ductwork and components as part of your system.

Chimney Work

Cleaning and servicing chimneys as part of our full home air-flow lineup.

Built around one habit: looking closely.

Hawk Eye Duct Cleaning is an independently owned Arizona business — every visit is done in person, by the same hands-on approach from start to finish.

The idea behind the name is simple: don't guess, inspect. Every job starts with a real look at your system, and you'll always know exactly what we found and what it costs before any work begins.

Questions

Frequently asked

What's included in the $99 visit?

Air duct cleaning, dryer vent cleaning, and a full system inspection with photo documentation. If the inspection turns up repair, replacement, or sanitation work, you'll get a clear, itemized price before we do any of it.

Do you only clean ducts, or also handle repairs?

Both. Our lineup covers duct and dryer vent cleaning, duct and dryer vent repair, duct replacement, sanitation, attic installation, and chimney work — one team for the whole job.

How long does a visit usually take?

A standard visit without any additional work usually runs around 40 minutes. It can run longer if you choose to move forward with any recommended add-ons.

What if I just want the free estimate?

That's exactly what it's for. We'll do a full walkthrough and give you a written, honest answer — including "you don't need anything right now" if that's the truth. No pressure to book further.

What areas do you serve?

We cover the Phoenix metro area and the wider Valley — see the full list of cities above. If you're nearby but don't see your city, reach out anyway.

How do I book a visit?

Fill out the request form below with your city and what you're looking for. We'll follow up to lock in a time that works for you.
